title: AI Document Intelligence Platform
summary: Enterprise document operations platform for extracting data, classifying files, and routing human review with AI-assisted workflows.
description: An enterprise platform that automatically processes documents, extracts structured data, and routes downstream workflows using AI. It is designed for organizations handling high volumes of scanned forms, handwritten submissions, and compliance-heavy document pipelines.
whyItMatters: Shows SofGent's strength in OCR systems, AI pipelines, and operational workflow automation for regulated industries.

title: Enterprise Knowledge AI (EasyKT)
summary: A company knowledge layer that turns documents, training materials, and video archives into an internal AI assistant and search system.
description: An AI-powered knowledge system that converts company documents, videos, and training materials into a searchable intelligence layer. It enables teams to build an internal ChatGPT experience trained on company-specific knowledge.
impact: Companies build an internal ChatGPT trained on company knowledge.
whyItMatters: Positions SofGent as a builder of enterprise AI systems that connect knowledge retrieval, search, and operational tooling.

title: AI Backlog Intelligence System
summary: An engineering intelligence layer for analyzing Jira tickets, requirements, and backlog data to improve planning and prioritization.
description: An AI platform that analyzes Jira tickets, engineering documents, and backlog data to automatically organize, summarize, and prioritize work. It is built for CTOs and engineering leaders who need more signal from growing delivery complexity.
impact: Highly attractive to CTOs because it directly improves engineering planning, execution clarity, and delivery forecasting.
whyItMatters: Makes SofGent's engineering systems expertise visible in a way that speaks to technical decision makers rather than just end-user UX.

title: Digital Wallet Infrastructure Platform (EasyCash)
summary: A modular wallet and ledger foundation for fintech startups and payment products that need controlled transaction flows and compliance-ready architecture.
description: A modular digital wallet system designed for fintech startups and payment platforms. It provides the core infrastructure needed to manage balances, monitor activity, and connect payment services through an API-driven architecture.
whyItMatters: Demonstrates strong fintech infrastructure design across ledgers, workflows, integrations, and compliance-sensitive backend systems.

title: Multi-Tenant SaaS Platform Engine
summary: A reusable platform architecture for launching secure multi-tenant SaaS products with tenancy, roles, billing, and scalable APIs built in.
description: A scalable platform architecture for building multi-tenant SaaS products. It is designed for teams that need a serious backend foundation before layering product-specific workflows on top.
whyItMatters: Shows deep SaaS architecture expertise and reinforces SofGent's ability to build systems meant to scale beyond MVP stage.

title: AI Knowledge Audit System
summary: A consulting-oriented AI system for identifying knowledge gaps, documenting workflows, and generating operational guidance from company materials.
description: A system that analyzes company documents and workflows to detect knowledge gaps and operational inefficiencies. It can function as a SofGent consulting product for diagnosing process issues and generating structured operational outputs.
whyItMatters: Creates a bridge between SofGent's consulting value and its product engineering depth by turning audits into platformized workflows.

title: AI Powered Training Platform
summary: An internal learning platform that transforms company training materials into interactive lessons, onboarding flows, and retention loops.
description: A system that converts company training materials into interactive learning experiences. It is designed to help companies modernize onboarding, improve training consistency, and measure knowledge retention across teams.
whyItMatters: Extends SofGent's AI knowledge positioning into learning systems where content processing, retrieval, and user engagement meet.

title: AI Commerce Platform
summary: An AI-driven commerce architecture for catalog ingestion, product content generation, recommendations, and multi-store operations.
description: A next-generation e-commerce platform with AI-driven catalog management and automated product content generation. It is structured for businesses that need smarter merchandising operations and scalable commerce foundations.
whyItMatters: Shows SofGent can apply AI systems thinking beyond internal tools into revenue-driving commerce workflows and product infrastructure.

title: Secure Remote Development Platform
summary: A secure browser-based development environment for teams that need isolated workspaces, enterprise controls, and auditable access.
description: A cloud-based development workspace that enables teams to code securely inside controlled environments. It is designed for organizations that need tighter security boundaries without sacrificing developer productivity.
whyItMatters: Connects SofGent's engineering credibility to secure developer tooling, infrastructure automation, and controlled enterprise environments.

title: Enterprise AI Integration Platform
summary: A connective AI platform for enterprise data sources that supports search, automation, document embeddings, and decision support workflows.
description: A platform that integrates enterprise data sources and provides AI capabilities such as search, automation, and decision support. It connects fragmented tools into a single AI-enabled operating layer.
capabilities: Connect to Jira, Drive, and Docs
whyItMatters: Reinforces SofGent's ability to build integration-heavy AI platforms that sit across systems instead of living as isolated demos.
